description: This Java interface defines a contract for filtering header entry values, allowing implementations to modify, validate, or filter out header values based on specific criteria. It includes a functional method for applying the filter and a default method for chaining filters together.

classes.name: HeaderEntryFilter
classes.description: A functional interface for filtering header entry values, with support for chaining multiple filters.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Filters the header entry identified by the key, possibly modifying or filtering out the value; returns null if the entry should be filtered out.

methods.name: andThen
methods.description: Creates a composite filter that applies this filter first, then applies the specified filter to the result.
